factBoundaries.subject: member birth dates
factBoundaries.result: All five existing native-design birth dates agree with the current official named cards. Roles, nationalities, Chinese-name official status and current activity were not reverified in this bounded task.

factBoundaries.subject: formal debut
factBoundaries.result: The official profile prose supports October 2023; its release history gives MACARONI CHEESE 2023-10-18. The exact group debut claim requires its separately recorded KBS/other explicit debut evidence; do not infer exact debut solely from album date.

factBoundaries.subject: young tape units
factBoundaries.scope: Explicit audio track billing; not automatic verification of all actors in any exact MV or stage. Do not assign the entire current roster to these unit tracks.

factBoundaries.subject: OST cover
factBoundaries.result: The Head over Heels Part 2 cover is correctly labeled for UPSIDE DOWN by YOUNG POSSE. Its drama character photograph is release artwork, not a YOUNG POSSE member portrait.

factBoundaries.subject: Haze
factBoundaries.result: Existing three-member mapping is supported. Daybreak is a separate instrumental track, not Haze instrumental.
